index.p_what: Conquer is a turn-based fantasy strategy game for many players, first released on Usenet in 1987 by Ed Barlow and Adam Bryant. This server runs version 4.12 of the original game, now free software under the GPL. Each player rules a nation: build cities, raise armies, cast magic, trade and negotiate with other rulers, and expand across a shared world.
index.note_join: Joining is by invitation, and takes two steps: an account for this website, then your nation inside the game.
index.join1: Write to the game administrator for an invite code.
index.join2: Your account for this website: choose Create your account (under the buttons at the top), type the code and choose a name and a password. It only opens the door of the site; your browser asks for it when you press Play.
index.join3: Your nation: press Play now and sign in with that account. The 1987 game asks you to found your nation: its own name (up to 9 letters), race, class and a nation password. From then on, Play now opens it directly.
index.turns1: Log in as often as you like to give orders: move armies, draft troops, build, trade, send messages.
index.turns2: All orders are resolved together at the next turn update, on the schedule shown under Current game; the in-game menu shows it too, with the last update.
index.turns3: Before each update, players still in the game are warned and, a few minutes later, disconnected; their orders are saved. Press <kbd>q</kbd> to quit the game when you are done.
index.turns4: When you quit, the menu asks whether your orders for the turn are done. Once every nation is done, the update can run right away instead of waiting for the schedule.
index.before1: Conquer is controlled entirely with keys, so a computer keyboard is the most comfortable. On phones and tablets an on-screen key bar provides Esc, Enter, movement and other common keys; use the Keyboard button to type names and passwords.
index.before2: The game needs a terminal of at least 80×24 characters. If the menu warns that the screen is too small, enlarge the window or zoom out with Ctrl + -.
index.before3: If the screen looks garbled, press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>L</kbd> to redraw it.
index.before4: The game itself is in English.
index.footer: Conquer is free software (GPL-3.0-or-later). Source: game · web server

join.title: Create your website account
join.lede: Playing Conquer takes two keys. This page makes the first one.
join.h_code: From the game administrator. It works once.
join.h_account: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. It is not your nation's name: you choose that later, inside the game.
join.h_password: At least 8 characters. You will sign in with it on this site.
join.nocode: No invite code? Ask the game administrator for one.
join.done_title: First key ready: your account for this website
join.done1: Press Play now. Your browser shows a small sign-in window: type
join.done1b: and the password you just chose.
join.done2: Second key: the game asks you to found your nation. Choose its name (up to 9 letters), race and class, and a nation password. Save at the end with Esc and then y.
join.done3: From then on, Play now and your account take you straight to your nation, which asks for its password.
join.e_bad_code: That invite code is not valid, or it has been used already. It looks like K7QM-3XPA.
join.e_account_taken: That account name is taken. Choose another.
join.e_bad_account: Use only letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores (up to 32).
join.e_short_password: Use at least 8 characters for the password.
join.e_bad_password: That password cannot be used: use at most 128 characters, on one line.
join.e_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
join.e_too_late: The game is past turn 5: new nations are added by the administrator. Write to them; your code stays valid.
join.e_closed: Sign-up is closed on this server right now.
join.e_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
join.e_server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, or write to the administrator.
join.e_network: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
join.step1_t: 1. Your account for this website (here, now)
join.step1: A name and a password that open the door of the site. Your browser asks for them in a small window each time you press Play. It is not your nation: other players never see it.
join.step2: Conquer is a game from 1987 that runs in a terminal. After you sign in, it asks you to found your nation: its name (up to 9 letters, it can differ from your account), race, class, and a nation password the game asks for every time you play.
join.done_private: If the browser does not ask and signs you in as someone else (it remembers the last account used on this site), open this site in a private window.
